title: Duplicated scene in wroing seasons
description:
I find some data are wrong in the tibble `friends`, for instance:
```
library(friends)
library(tidyverse)
friends %>% filter(season==4,episode==21,scene==16) %>% select(text)%>% print(n = Inf)
```
This scene is in Season 1. I find duplicated entries in Season 1 too. Is there any way to check this data and make it right?

Thanks.
